note: Full-image variants preserve every barcode and background. Zoomed variants transform the same photo inside a fixed viewport, centered on the first detected barcode (Medium first), or the image center if none is found. Background and other barcodes can leave the viewport; no code is digitally removed. Zoom targets the limiting frame dimension, capped at 8× magnification; it uses interpolation, not new image detail. The selected barcode gets a 10% margin where its estimated bounds allow.
